attchmntText: Bang Overseas Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bang Overseas Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The standalone profit for the half year was Rs. 45.27 Lakhs, with earnings per share of Rs. 0.33. The consolidated profit for the half year was Rs. 74.02 Lakhs, with earnings per share of Rs. 0.55. The financial statements were reviewed by Statutory Auditors M/s Bharat Gupta & Co, who issued a clean limited review report. The meeting commenced at 12.00 P.M. and concluded at 5.40 P.M.
